full_name: Lightcone Infrastructure (LessWrong · AI Alignment Forum · Lighthaven)
mission: Lightcone Infrastructure builds the online and physical spaces where much AI safety thinking happens. It runs LessWrong, a community blog about rationality and AI, and the AI Alignment Forum for technical alignment research, plus the Lighthaven campus and event venue in Berkeley. It also designs websites for AI forecasting projects such as AI 2027.

key_work.title: LessWrong
key_work.plain_summary: A community blog 'devoted to refining the art of rationality' and a central venue for discussion of AI risk and alignment.

key_work.title: AI Alignment Forum
key_work.plain_summary: A curated forum for technical AI alignment research, where many safety researchers post and debate their work.

key_work.title: Lighthaven
key_work.plain_summary: A campus and event venue in Berkeley that hosts AI safety conferences, retreats and workshops.

key_work.title: AI 2027 (website design)
key_work.plain_summary: Lightcone designed the site for the AI Futures Project's AI 2027 scenario, a detailed forecast of how superhuman AI might arrive.
